textbookBox.concept: WHO defines health as complete physical, mental, emotional, and social well-being. Social health means interacting positively and harmoniously with family, peers, and society.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: WHO defines health as complete physical, mental, emotional, and social well-being. Social health means interacting positively and harmoniously with family, peers, and society.
beats.speakEn: WHO defines health as complete physical, mental, emotional, and social well-being. Social health means interacting positively and harmoniously with family, peers, and society.

beats.en: Socially healthy people listen respectfully, practise equality (like Arun insisting a poor boy not be pushed to the back of a food queue), admit mistakes, and reconnect with old friends.
